title: Keep a turnless Codex completion from creating a check in a successor turn
outcome: A turnless Codex command completion without an exact current start cannot create a check in a successor turn. Exact carried completions settle only their original execution, and a proven current start may reuse the tool key.
acceptance: A production-route test drives two ordinary turns on the same Codex runtime and thread, then delivers a late or repeated turnless completion for a recognizable test without a current start. The successor trace, checks and producer payload contain no occurrence for that completion.
A carried original execution still receives its terminal result exactly once, and a separately proven current start reusing the key still receives its own completion.
